verdict.rationale: The evidence only touches this indirectly. Mailchimp Transactional sends 'event-driven messages via the API', so a developer can call it per user when an event happens, and the Marketing API uses 'custom data pulled directly from your app'. Neither shows a custom-event ingestion endpoint that triggers a Marketing automation for a single contact, and the webhooks described are outbound only (Mailchimp notifying your app). Missing for 10: a documented custom-event API, event-triggered automation (customer journey) configuration, per-contact targeting from the fired event, and hands-on corroboration.
